It belongs to its item and is published with it (ADR-004).\nNot a Report's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment","newString":"**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body and\nstored there as `image:<name>`. It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14). Stored in the body as a `chart` block the\nwriter never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14).\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view, public preview","originalFile":"# Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**Chart image**:\nA PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a graph made in Excel, R, or Tableau)\nthat a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its Markdown body as\n`image:<name>`. It belongs to its item and is published with it (ADR-004).\nNot a Report's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review surveys).\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":43,"oldLines":12,"newStart":43,"newLines":32,"lines":[" _Avoid_: Live, public"," "," **Chart image**:","-A PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a graph made in Excel, R, or Tableau)","-that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its Markdown body as","-`image:<name>`. It belongs to its item and is published with it (ADR-004).","-Not a Report's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.","+An *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,","+or Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body and","+stored there as `image:<name>`. It belongs to its item and is published with","+it (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a","+Report's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download."," _Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment"," ","+**Chart**:","+A bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or","+pasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data","+available as a table (spec #14). Stored in the body as a `chart` block the","+writer never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.","+_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization","+","+**Editor**:","+The visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,","+tables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.","+The body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14).","+_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor","+","+**Site preview**:","+A Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the","+site's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves","+nothing and publishes nothing.","+_Avoid_: live view, public preview","+"," **Confirmation**:"," The one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,"," upload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). {"parentUuid":"90863fd9-b3b7-45b6-9d15-dad4026aa554","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaBQxEu2uw4v7gYhQWsm","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015JRBv2WyAVBuxdvoN9wfGZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-davelleat-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc/scratchpad/tickets.md","content":"=== T12: Site preview\n## Parent\n\nPart of #14\n\n## What to build\n\nA Data Bite's or Report's edit page shows a **Site preview**: the item rendered through the public templates, `public_site.CSS`, and the site nav, as if it were published, beside the body field. The current admin-styled preview is replaced. A \"Preview on site\" button opens the same rendering in a new tab, and both show the current **unsaved** edits. This ticket works with today's Markdown textarea. T13 feeds the preview from the Editor instead.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The Site preview renders the item's own public page (title, date line, body, Report file link, chart images) through the public templates and stylesheet, with every link and asset relative, as the export does\n- [ ] The item appears **as if published**: a draft Report is in the nav of its own Site preview. Every other draft stays hidden in the preview, and no draft appears anywhere else\n- [ ] Every Site preview shows a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner, including for an already-published item\n- [ ] The preview is an embedded frame beside the body field that drops below it on narrow screens, with a Desktop/Phone width toggle. It updates as the body is typed (debounced, as today), and the \"not updating\" message still appears when the session has ended\n- [ ] \"Preview on site\" posts the unsaved form to a new tab and shows the same rendering. Nothing is saved\n- [ ] The create page (no item yet) gets a Site preview too, without chart images\n- [ ] Preview routes require login and CSRF, follow the item's permissions (ADR-003), save nothing, and change nothing in `site/`\n- [ ] Tests: banner, public stylesheet, relative links at every depth, a draft Report in its own preview's nav and nowhere else, nothing saved, login and CSRF required. T07/T08 crawl and draft-leak tests still pass\n- [ ] Browser check (Chrome and Safari) recorded in the closing comment: the browser version, viewport (390 and 1280), each action, the observed result, and screenshots\n\n## Blocked by\n\nNone. Can start immediately.\n\n=== T13: Editor\n## Parent\n\nPart of #14\n\n## What to build\n\nThe **Editor** replaces the Markdown textarea on every Data Bite and Report edit and create page: `contenteditable` plus a toolbar, in vanilla JS with no dependency. The body is still stored as Markdown. The server sanitizes the Editor's HTML with nh3 and converts it to Markdown with a new stdlib `html.parser` module. It keeps an untouched body byte-for-byte, locks blocks it can't represent, and refuses stale saves. The Editor feeds the T12 Site preview. Record the decision in **ADR-005: The Editor stores Markdown**.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] Toolbar: bold, italic, bulleted list, numbered list, link (external `https:`/`mailto:` only here; the site-link picker is T14), Section (H2), Subsection (H3), block quote\n- [ ] Paste keeps only the supported formatting (no fonts, colours, or spacing). A pasted or dropped picture is refused with a message pointing to \"Insert image\". A pasted HTML table is kept as a basic table (T15 adds editing)\n- [ ] The form carries `item_base` (SHA-256 of the stored title, slug, and body) and `body_dirty`. A stale `item_base` refuses the whole save with the \"changed since you opened it\" error, and no field is written\n- [ ] With `body_dirty=0`, the stored body is kept byte-for-byte whatever HTML is posted. Opening the Editor never rewrites a body\n- [ ] An edited body is saved in standard Markdown form\n- [ ] Locked blocks work as the spec describes: detected per top-level block from markdown-it line maps, replaced by `locked-<n>` tokens, and shown read-only as sanitized rendered HTML with a Remove button. Their raw Markdown bytes never reach the browser. On save they're restored from the stored body, an unknown or duplicated token refuses the save, and a removed token drops only that block\n- [ ] A warning appears when leaving with unsaved changes, and there's no autosave\n- [ ] If the script fails to load, the plain textarea still works and posts Markdown. All existing tests pass unchanged\n- [ ] ADR-005 is written, and CONTEXT.md's **Editor** entry links to it\n- [ ] Tests:\n  - Untouched is byte-for-byte, and a no-change round trip over standard form renders equivalent HTML for every seed body and every T09/T10 fixture\n  - A one-block edit changes only that block's rendered HTML\n  - Locked blocks: their bytes survive neighbouring edits, the response carries no raw source, and forged, duplicated, or unknown tokens are refused\n  - A stale `item_base` is refused, including the **title/slug conflict** (tab B changes only the title or slug, and tab A's save of an untouched body is refused)\n  - Hostile Editor HTML (`<script>`, `on*=`, `style=`, `javascript:`, unknown tags) never survives to any render\n- [ ] Browser check (Chrome and Safari) recorded in the closing comment: toolbar, paste from Word/Docs, leave warning, and fallback with JS disabled, each with the browser version, viewport, actions, result, and screenshots\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- T12 (the Editor feeds the Site preview)\n\n=== T14: Links to Reports and Data Bites\n## Parent\n\nPart of #14\n\n## What to build\n\nWriters link to another Report or Data Bite by picking it from a list. The link is stored as `report:<ref>` or `data-bite:<ref>`, by a new immutable `ref`, and resolved to a page-relative path at render time. A target that can't be resolved renders as plain text. The render pipeline enforces the restated rule for every body: an `<a>` survives only as `https:`, `mailto:`, or a resolved site reference, and only `image:<name>` renders an `<img>`. The hard rule's wording and the crawler change in this ticket too.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] `ref` column on `data_bites` and `reports`: `secrets.token_hex(16)`, added through `ADDED_COLUMNS`, backfilled by `init_db`, with a unique index on each table, and never changed by editing the title or slug\n- [ ] `deleted_refs(kind, ref, deleted_at)`: deleting an item writes its tombstone in the same transaction\n- [ ] A new ref is checked against both tables and `deleted_refs` in the insert's transaction, and retried on collision (it fails loudly after 3 attempts)\n- [ ] The Editor's link dialog has \"A page on this site\" (a picker listing Reports and Data Bites by title and marking which are drafts) and \"A web address\" (`https:` or `mailto:` only; anything else is refused with a message)\n- [ ] At render time: a resolved published target gets a correct relative href at every depth, in the public site, the export, and the Site preview. A draft, unpublished, deleted, or never-existing target renders as link text with no `<a>`\n- [ ] Every other href (`http:`, `javascript:`, root-absolute, relative typed by hand) renders as plain text, whichever save path it came from\n- [ ] An absolute image URL renders no `<img>`. `tests/test_t10_chart_images.py`'s \"other image URLs\" test is updated to match\n- [ ] The Editor marks unresolvable links \"Not published: will show as plain text\", \"Item deleted\", or \"Unknown link\"\n- [ ] Deleting an item lists the items whose bodies link to it, and the delete isn't blocked\n- [ ] The CLAUDE.md hard rule reads \"Site-owned links and assets use **relative** paths only. Never `href=\"/...\"` or `src=\"/...\"`. Explicit external links may use `https:` or `mailto:`.\" ADR-001 gets a matching note\n- [ ] The T07/T08 crawler skips `https:`/`mailto:` `<a href>`s. It still fails on root-absolute paths, any other `://` URL, and any non-relative `src`, and it still fetches every internal link. A test injects a bad URL and shows the crawler fails\n- [ ] Tests: everything above, including the **id-reuse** test (delete the target, create a new Report that may reuse its id, and the link is still plain text and \"Item deleted\") and the **tombstoned-ref** test (the generator is forced to return a deleted ref first, and the insert retries)\n- [ ] Browser check recorded in the closing comment: the picker, the external-link refusal, and the three markers, each with the browser version, viewport, actions, result, and screenshots\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- T13\n\n=== T15: Tables in the Editor\n## Parent\n\nPart of #14\n\n## What to build\n\nTables in the Editor are built and edited in place: insert a table, click a cell and type, and add or remove rows and columns with controls that appear while the cursor is in the table. A range pasted from Excel or Sheets becomes one. A table is stored as a Markdown table (T09's styling and scroll wrapper unchanged). The first row is the header, and numeric columns are right-aligned automatically.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] An \"Insert table\" button makes a 3×3 table with a header row. Controls add a row above or below, add a column left or right, and remove a row, a column, or the table\n- [ ] A pasted Excel or Sheets range (HTML table or tab-separated text) becomes an Editor table. Merged cells are unmerged, and the value goes in the first cell\n- [ ] The first row is always the header row\n- [ ] A column is right-aligned when every non-empty cell is numeric under the spec's rules: commas, a leading `-` or `$`, a trailing `%`, `(3.2)`. Blank, `—`, and `n/a` don't stop it counting as numeric. Other columns are left-aligned\n- [ ] Bold, italic, and links inside cells survive. A pipe character in a cell is escaped\n- [ ] Tests: Excel-style HTML becomes the expected Markdown table, numeric detection works across every format, pipes are escaped, and round trips stay stable\n- [ ] Browser check recorded in the closing comment: paste from Excel and from Sheets, each control, and a wide table at 390px, each with the browser version, viewport, actions, result, and screenshots\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- T13\n\n=== T16: Chart rendering\n## Parent\n\nPart of #14\n\n## What to build\n\nThe server side of **Charts**, with no builder UI yet. It covers:\n- the version-1 `chart` fence grammar, with strict JSON parsed by stdlib `json` and a canonical serialization\n- validation on **every** save path\n- the number, unit, missing, and suppressed rules\n- the SVG drawing and the \"Show the data\" table, inserted after nh3 behind the trusted-SVG boundary\n\nRecord the decision in **ADR-006: Charts drawn from data**, which reverses ADR-004's deferral.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The grammar is exactly as the spec's table describes (keys, types, limits, single-line NFC strings, 32 KB cap). Unknown or duplicate keys, `NaN`/`Infinity`, and trailing data make a block invalid\n- [ ] A body with an invalid `chart` block is refused with a named error on the Editor save path **and** the Markdown fallback. Canonical serialization is stable\n- [ ] Number parsing and units: `$` is a prefix, `%` a suffix, and a word is a suffix after a space. One unit per chart, and a conflict names its first cell. Any other currency is an error. Blank, `—`, and `n/a` are missing. `*`, `<N`, `≤N`, and `<=N` are suppressed\n- [ ] Drawing:\n  - Vertical bar, horizontal bar, and line; 1 to 4 series with a legend when there's more than one; the fixed palette\n  - Bar charts start at zero, and a line chart that starts above zero says so\n  - Values are labelled as typed. Missing and suppressed values draw no mark, and a line has a gap\n  - The privacy note appears once, and the source line goes under the chart\n- [ ] Accessibility: `role=\"img\"`, the title as the accessible name through `aria-labelledby`, and a `<details>` \"Show the data\" table that keeps the original notation\n- [ ] Trusted boundary:\n  - The per-render `secrets.token_hex(16)` placeholder occurs exactly once and is replaced exactly once, or the render fails loudly\n  - Every value passes `math.isfinite`\n  - Only the fixed elements and attributes are emitted, `fill`/`stroke` are palette constants, `class` is a fixed name, `id` is `chart-<nonce>-<n>-title`, and there's no `href`, `style`, or `on*`\n  - Writer strings appear only as escaped text content\n- [ ] An invalid block reaching render outputs only \"This chart could not be shown.\"\n- [ ] Site preview, public page, and export all show Charts, and the export stays identical to the live site\n- [ ] ADR-006 is written, and CONTEXT.md's **Chart** entry links to it\n- [ ] Tests: every grammar violation on both save paths, every parsing case, the **structural allowlist test** (the rendered figure is parsed with `html.parser`, and its element and attribute sets, palette, class, and id patterns are checked), hostile strings as escaped text, an inert placeholder typed by the writer, distinct placeholders for two charts, the zero baseline, and a single privacy note\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- T13 (the Editor save path must validate chart blocks)\n\n=== T17: Chart builder\n## Parent\n\nPart of #14\n\n## What to build\n\nThe Editor's \"Insert chart\" dialog. It has a grid with categories down and series across that accepts typing and a paste from Excel or Sheets, the chart fields, a live chart drawn by the T16 server rendering, and errors next to the cells that cause them. In the body, a Chart is a card showing the drawn chart, with Edit and Remove.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The dialog has type (vertical bar, horizontal bar, line), title (required), x- and y-axis labels, Units (one field, stored as a prefix or suffix), Source/note, and the grid. Series can be added or removed (1 to 4) and so can categories (up to the type's limit)\n- [ ] A paste from Excel or Sheets fills the grid from the selected cell. The first row and column become names when they aren't numeric\n- [ ] The chart is redrawn as the writer edits, by the same server rendering the public page uses. Each error from T16's validation shows next to its cell or field, and Insert is disabled until the chart is valid\n- [ ] A long category label suggests horizontal bar without switching to it\n- [ ] In the body, a Chart is a card showing the drawn chart. Edit reopens the dialog with its data, and Remove deletes it. The card round-trips as the canonical `chart` block\n- [ ] Tests: the preview endpoint the dialog uses requires login and CSRF, saves nothing, and returns T16's errors as field-level messages\n- [ ] Browser check recorded in the closing comment: typing, paste from Excel, one error of each kind, a 4-series line chart, Edit and Remove, and the dialog at 390px, each with the browser version, viewport, actions, result, and screenshots\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- T16\n\n=== T18: Chart images in the Editor\n## Parent\n\nPart of #14\n\n## What to build\n\nThe Editor's \"Insert image\" button lists the item's uploaded **Chart images** and inserts one at the cursor, after a required description (alt). It's stored as `![Description](image:<name>)` as today. Upload, validation, permissions, and publishing (ADR-004) are unchanged.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] \"Insert image\" lists the item's Chart images with thumbnails. A description is required before Insert is enabled\n- [ ] An inserted image shows in the Editor and the Site preview, and is stored as `![Description](image:<name>)`\n- [ ] Clicking an image in the body lets the writer change its description or remove it\n- [ ] On the create page (no item yet), the button explains that images can be added after the first save\n- [ ] The copy-a-snippet list from T10/T11 is removed from the edit page, and the undescribed-image warning stays for existing content\n- [ ] A pasted or dropped picture is still refused with the pointer to this button (from T13)\n- [ ] Tests: the stored Markdown for an insert, an empty description refused by the server, and the existing T10/T11 tests still pass\n- [ ] Browser check recorded in the closing comment: insert, change the description, remove, and the create-page message, each with the browser version, viewport, actions, result, and screenshots\n\n## Blocked by\n\n- T13\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":683,"cache_read_input_tokens":115608,"output_tokens":5811,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":683,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":5811,"cache_read_input_tokens":115608,"cache_creation_input_tokens":683,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":683},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_015JRBv2WyAVBuxdvoN9wfGZ":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-davelleat-code-iphs400-mp2-cms/d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc/scratchpad/tickets.md","content":"=== The current admin-styled preview is replaced. A \"Preview on site\" button opens the same rendering in a new tab, and both show the current **unsaved** edits. This ticket works with today's Markdown textarea. T13 feeds the preview from the Editor instead.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] The Site preview renders the item's own public page (title, date line, body, Report file link, chart images) through the public templates and stylesheet, with every link and asset relative, as the export does\n- [ ] The item appears **as if published**: a draft Report is in the nav of its own Site preview. Every other draft stays hidden in the preview, and no draft appears anywhere else\n- [ ] Every Site preview shows a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner, including for an already-published item\n- [ ] The preview is an embedded frame beside the body field that drops below it on narrow screens, with a Desktop/Phone width toggle. Nothing is saved\n- [ ] The create page (no item yet) gets a Site preview too, without chart images\n- [ ] Preview routes require login and CSRF, follow the item's permissions (ADR-003), save nothing, and change nothing in `site/`\n- [ ] Tests: banner, public stylesheet, relative links at every depth, a draft Report in its own preview's nav and nowhere else, nothing saved, login and CSRF required. T07/T08 crawl and draft-leak tests still pass\n- [ ] Browser check (Chrome and Safari) recorded in the closing comment: the browser version, viewport (390 and 1280), each action, the observed result, and screenshots\n\n## Blocked by\n\nNone. The body is still stored as Markdown. The server sanitizes the Editor's HTML with nh3 and converts it to Markdown with a new stdlib `html.parser` module. It keeps an untouched body byte-for-byte, locks blocks it can't represent, and refuses stale saves. The Editor feeds the T12 Site preview. Record the decision in **ADR-005: The Editor stores Markdown**.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] Toolbar: bold, italic, bulleted list, numbered list, link (external `https:`/`mailto:` only here; the site-link picker is T14), Section (H2), Subsection (H3), block quote\n- [ ] Paste keeps only the supported formatting (no fonts, colours, or spacing). A pasted or dropped picture is refused with a message pointing to \"Insert image\". A pasted HTML table is kept as a basic table (T15 adds editing)\n- [ ] The form carries `item_base` (SHA-256 of the stored title, slug, and body) and `body_dirty`. A stale `item_base` refuses the whole save with the \"changed since you opened it\" error, and no field is written\n- [ ] With `body_dirty=0`, the stored body is kept byte-for-byte whatever HTML is posted. Opening the Editor never rewrites a body\n- [ ] An edited body is saved in standard Markdown form\n- [ ] Locked blocks work as the spec describes: detected per top-level block from markdown-it line maps, replaced by `locked-<n>` tokens, and shown read-only as sanitized rendered HTML with a Remove button. Their raw Markdown bytes never reach the browser. {"parentUuid":"2882196a-67f4-440e-963c-9b336a4a604c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfaBVMJ5h15peDQS2d98w","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've created spec [#14](https://github.com/DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/14) and committed the `CONTEXT.md` update as `c5d3b13`, which isn't pushed yet. The seven ticket drafts are in `…/scratchpad/tickets.md` and haven't been created on GitHub.\n\n**Spec #14** has your four corrections:\n- **Links in the Solution section** are \"stored by immutable reference\".\n- **Stale saves:** the form carries `item_base`, a hash of the stored title, slug and body. If any of them changed since the page loaded, the whole save is refused. A test covers the case where another tab changed only the title or slug.\n- **New refs** come from `secrets.token_hex(16)`. Inside the insert's transaction they're checked against both tables and `deleted_refs`, with up to 3 retries on a collision. A test forces a deleted ref first to prove the retry works.\n- **Locked blocks:** their raw Markdown never reaches the browser. The writer sees the block's sanitized rendered HTML, read-only.\n\nBoth behaviour changes you approved are in the spec too. Hand-typed relative links and absolute image URLs now render as plain text or nothing, and T14 updates the T10 test that allowed external images.\n\n**Glossary:** Chart, Editor and Site preview are added, and Chart image is now described as uploaded. I left \"public preview\" out of the words to avoid for Site preview, because `app/cli.py` already uses that phrase for the locally served public site.\n\n**Tickets, in order:** T12 → T13 → T14, T15 and T16 (T16 → T17) and T18.\n\n| Ticket | Blocked by | What it covers |\n|---|---|---|\n| T12 Site preview | — | Replaces the admin preview. Includes the Desktop/Phone toggle, the new-tab view, the banner, and the item shown as if published. |\n| T13 Editor + ADR-005 | T12 | Toolbar, paste cleanup, `item_base`/`body_dirty`, locked blocks, leave warning, textarea fallback. |\n| T14 Links | T13 | Picker, `ref` column, `deleted_refs`, link rules applied at render time, the CLAUDE.md rule change and the crawler change. |\n| T15 Tables | T13 | Edited in place, Excel/Sheets paste, header row, numeric columns right-aligned. |\n| T16 Chart rendering + ADR-006 | T13 | Grammar, validation on both save paths, SVG, \"Show the data\", the allowlist test. No UI. |\n| T17 Chart builder | T16 | Dialog with grid, paste, live chart, errors next to cells, chart card in the body. |\n| T18 Chart images in the Editor | T13 | \"Insert image\" button with a required description. |\n\n**Decisions in the drafts that weren't settled in the grill:**\n1. **T12:** the create page gets a Site preview too, without chart images.\n2. **T13 before T15 exists:** a pasted Excel table is kept as a basic table rather than dropped, and the link button allows external links only until T14 adds the picker.\n3. **T14:** the picker marks which items are drafts.\n4. **T15:** \"Insert table\" starts at 3×3. When a pasted range has merged cells, they're unmerged and the value goes in the first cell.\n5. **T16 depends on T13:** chart validation has to run on the Editor's save path, and that path doesn't exist until T13.\n6. **T17:** when data is pasted, the first row and column become series and category names if they aren't numbers. Insert stays disabled until the chart is valid.\n7. **T18:**\n   - It removes the old copy-a-snippet image list.\n   - The required description is enforced only in the Editor. The server keeps ADR-004's warning without blocking the save, so existing content with an empty description still saves.\n\nUI tickets end with a browser check recorded in the closing comment: browser version, viewport, actions, result, and screenshots.\n\nAs agreed, I'll stop after T12 and T13 for a checkpoint.
